glossdef.p: The operating system (OS) runs the computer and allows you to run programs on your hardware. The most popular operating system is Windows, although alternatives such as Linux exist.

Technically, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) licenses are only available to companies that build computers, not individual hobbyists. However, it is easy to get an OEM Windows license for half the price of a retail license from reputable retailers such as Wal-Mart.

Whether you choose Windows or another option you will need some method of installing your OS on your new machine. You can either use a DVD drive or an 8 GB+ flash drive with a disc image installed on it.
